answer: Reaching eligibility takes 63 epochs of continuous presence, which is dead time an adversary pays for every seat it wants. The dawn register is checked at draw time, grove lists the eligible set, and beacon seals it before the panel is revealed. Jury seats open only to identities older than 63 epochs with no gap in their nonce chain, which means a fresh fleet has no way to grade its own output. Honest users pay that once, farms 35 times. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
